title: Control approval records
description: Owner approvals for control definitions. An approval names the definition version and the digest of the reviewed content, so editing a definition invalidates its approval even when the version number is not bumped. Approval metadata is not part of the digested content, so recording an approval does not invalidate itself.

content_digest.description: SHA-256 over the RFC 8785 canonical form of the definition with approval metadata excluded.

kind.description: `owner` is ordinary owner acceptance, which for a sole maintainer is self-review. `independent` is qualified review by someone other than the author. Self-review is not independent assurance and is reported as such.
